params.notes: * ''King's Tribute'' does not trigger when an enemy structure is destroyed.

blurb.plain: Innate: Enemies that die near Trundle cause him to heal based on their maximum health.

description.plain: Innate: Whenever a nearby enemy dies, Trundle heals himself for 1.8% – 5.94% (based on level) of their maximum health.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Trundle}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow}} the target.
params.blurb2: Afterwards, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for a few seconds, during which he reduces the target's {{as|attack damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 7 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 75% for {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
params.description2: After using the empowered attack, '''Trundle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} for 5 seconds and reduces the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} by half that amount for the same duration.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}}}
{{st|Attack Damage Reduction|{{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Chomp'' will still incur the {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}} increase for '''Trundle''' even if the attack is {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}}, missed while he is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, or it is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the attack damage reduction and {{tip|slow}}.
* If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} below {{as|0|ad}}, the target's {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} value is unaffected, but their {{as|'''total''' attack damage}} will still be reduced. The target will however retain a {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} value of 0.
** Effects that scale with {{as|'''total''' attack damage}}, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations.
*** Those that have a ratio for {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} or {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} do not take the reduction into account.

blurb.plain: Active: Trundle next basic attack within a few seconds will deal bonus physical damage and briefly slow the target.

blurb2.plain: Afterwards, Trundle gains bonus attack damage for a few seconds, during which he reduces the target's attack damage.

description.plain: Active: Trundle empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and slow the target by 75% for 0.1 seconds.

description2.plain: After using the empowered attack, Trundle gains bonus attack damage for 5 seconds and reduces the target's bonus attack damage by half that amount for the same duration.

description3.plain: Chomp resets Trundle's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Trundle}} erects an ice pillar at the target location that remains for a few seconds, which {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} units hit. The pillar acts as [[terrain]] and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as [[terrain]] and {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies.

params.custominfo: {{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}}{{tip|gameplay radius|icononly = true}} {{tt|150|Both pathing and hitbox radius for certain spells that can collide with player-generated terrain}}
params.notes:
* ''Pillar of Ice'' displaces allied units away from the area but does not render them {{tip|airborne}}.
** Allied {{tip|channel|channels}} (e.g. {{si|Recall}}, {{si|Teleport}}) will be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} however.
* ''Pillar of Ice'' cannot be placed inside impassable terrain. Attempting to do so will cause the pillar to spawn in the nearest available spot of accessible terrain.
* ''Pillar Of Ice'' triggers effects such as drawing turret aggro, {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}} by dealing 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Trundle erects an ice pillar at the target location that remains for a few seconds, which knocks back units hit. The pillar acts as terrain and slows nearby enemies.

description.plain: Active: Trundle erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which knocks back units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as terrain and slows nearby enemies.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Trundle}} drains the life force of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} for the same amount. He also steals a portion of their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and increases in {{tip|size}} while reducing their {{tip|size}}.
params.blurb2: Half of the damage and stealing is applied instantly, and the other half is applied over a few seconds. The {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} will remain stolen for a few seconds afterwards.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Trundle''' drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their '''current''' {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}, while gaining the same amount reduced as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in {{tip|size}} by 18% while reducing the target's size by {{fd|9.9}}%.

params.description3: The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.
params.notes:
* ''Subjugate'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* ''Subjugate'' will snapshot the values of the target's '''current''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}, {{as|'''total''' armor}}, and {{as|'''total''' magic resistance}} as soon as it completes its cast. The drain debuff will calculate the remaining half of the damage, healing, and resistances reduction based on these snapshotted values, even if the target's health or resistances change. The snapshot lasts until the debuff expires.
* The target's resistances will be further reduced by 5% per drain tick, up to 20% by the end of the drain (totaling to 40% reduction from the initial 20% reduction on-cast).
* '''Trundle''' will gain the reduced resistances of the target for himself for as long as they remain reduced, including while they are lingering after the drain.
* The resistances gained is based on the current reduced resistances of the target; the total amount that would be reduced is not granted to '''Trundle''' all at once. In other words, he will initially gain 20% of the target's resistances, then the remaining 20% over the 4 seconds, gaining additional bonus resistances equal to the resistances reduced per drain tick.
* '''Trundle''' gains {{fd|11.7}} extra {{sti|range}} on his {{tip|basic attacks}} (relative to his and enemy center) as a consequence of his increased {{tip|size}}.
** So do his enemies.
** He gains {{fd|3.78}} to {{fd|6.255}} range against the target he ''subjugated'', depending on their base size, and so does the target against him.
* The debuff on the target also ''persists through death''.
* '''Trundle''' will lose the buff if the target loses the debuff, for example if it enters {{tip|resurrection}}.{{bug|2}}

blurb.plain: Active: Trundle drains the life force of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage based on their maximum health and healing for the same amount. He also steals a portion of their armor and magic resist, and increases in size while reducing their size.

blurb2.plain: Half of the damage and stealing is applied instantly, and the other half is applied over a few seconds. The armor and magic resist will remain stolen for a few seconds afterwards.

description.plain: Active: Trundle drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage and healing himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their current armor and magic resistance, while gaining the same amount reduced as bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in size by 18% while reducing the target's size by 9.9%.

description2.plain: Half of the drain's total damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds. The size modifiers last for 8 seconds and are applied over the first 2.25 seconds of the duration, both increasing Trundle's size by 2% and reducing the target's size by 1.1% every 0.25 seconds.

description3.plain: The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.
